reviews.t: Must have!
reviews.x: No spills, no troubles refiling and they meet TSA standards! I recently went on a two weeks holiday and still came back home with products I filled these amazing silicone bottles with. One of the best purchases I've made in the recent months! Super happy!

reviews.t: 5+ stars due to the leak proof cream jars
reviews.x: The silicone bottles are comparable to all of the silicone travel bottles on the market.  What sets the Alink travel set apart from the competition are the leak proof travel jars.  The jars come with a plastic insert for the lid that has prevented them from leaking while flying.  Every other jar I have leaks even if I try to make a home made cover with plastic wrap or cling wrap.  These jars are great.  If Alink made multiple sizes of the jars they would have the best no leak travel jars on the

reviews.t: No Worry, Leak Proof Jars and Travel Bottles.
reviews.x: These are really great travel assorted size bottles and jars.  The jars are small, however they hold a large amount of cream type product.  All are easy to fill.  I have traveled with these on several occasions and no leak issue what so ever.  The bottles also have turn dial labels, which also come with a no- label, if you have something other than what the labels read.

reviews.t: I used the little jars for lotion. I appreciated ...
reviews.x: I used the little jars for lotion. I appreciated the little insert before screwing on the top; it helped keep the lotion from leaking out. I would have given this set a 5; however, I wish there would have been a warning not to use the silicone bottles with oil based products (although I should have known better). reviews.t: Great for Travel! Very Durable!
reviews.x: These worked great for my kids; they took them to summer camp and the bottles worked well. I used the little canisters for foot cream and shaving gel--no leaks or troubles with them. I love how you can twist part of the cap of the bottles around so that it shows a label for what is in the bottle.

reviews.t: GREAT TRAVEL BOTTLES! Tested, used, durable, affordable, GREAT SELLER!
reviews.x: Honest, these bottles and jars are great. High quality. I love that a spatula was included for the jars. I wish it was one for each, but really, I love the attention to detail there. I have used these, just got back from a short trip, and they will be going with me to Spain in 2 weeks for holidays. They do what they say they will, easy fill, click dial for the label, squeeze every bit out, no leaks. The zip bag ripped on second use. That was no bother to me,I didn't need it. EXCELLENT seller com

reviews.t: As advertised - great little travel set!
reviews.x: After reading other reviews I purchased this for travel mainly because I liked the extra seal on the jars. I was not disappointed! The jars held my lotions and creams without any spillage. I was equally pleased with the squeeze bottles using them for shampoo, conditioner, body wash and my liquid make up remover. The large openings made it very easy to fill. The lids sealed properly, and dispenced my products in a controlled manner. Added bonus was the built in labeling system, with just a click/

Aside from that, they are sturdy and have not leaked when flying. The cap is a little hard to open, but that's ok, no worry it is going to open accidentally. Just a matter of time before all the caps pop off?  Too much of a hassle emptying the shampoo and conditioner out of the remaining bottles and returning.  I wish I could just exchange the largest bottle for a new one, but option not available.  These bottles are for travel, but cheap and I don't recommend!  So disappointed this is a Ama

reviews.t: the tubes are good, the tubs are very disappointing
reviews.x: the tubes are good, the tubs are very disappointing.  I paid more than I would have for this set to get the tubs thinking that they were silicone too, they are not.  they are a hard plastic that does not cinch doubt tight.  I MIGHT trust these with tablets or similar, they do not work for powder or semi-solid liquids/creams as a travel container.

reviews.t: I love that you can change what is in the bottle ...
reviews.x: I love that you can change what is in the bottle or make your own.  I will definitely be using this and not just for traveling.

reviews.t: They are wonderful. They hold a good amount of product
reviews.x: I have used these for several trips this summer including car and plane travel. They are wonderful. They hold a good amount of product, are easy to squeeze, and the wide mouth makes it easy to scoop out the last of the product with my finger. My only suggestion is to swap out one of the larger size bottles for another 2 oz. size.

reviews.t: satisfying squeeze
reviews.x: Didn't think I would be excited about bottles.  But I picked up some cheap ones at the local Walmart and was unimpressed.  My family needed more so I ordered these and wished I had just ordered two of these.  They feel nice and they actually squeeze easily, while the cheap ones were hard to squeeze.  I'm a fan.

reviews.t: ... these for travel and they have never failed us like other cheap plastic bottles we've purchased
reviews.x: We've purchased several of these for travel and they have never failed us like other cheap plastic bottles we've purchased. Nothing like opening up your luggage only to find shampoo leaked over everything! The ID tags on the bottom are very useful to ID what's in the bottle as well.

reviews.t: Perfect for my trip.
reviews.x: These are perfect for travel.  I really like the flexible silicone bottles and the smaller twist top containers for face products, lotions, etc.

reviews.t: The Alink silicone travel bottles worked great for our trip to South Carolina
reviews.x: The Alink silicone travel bottles worked great for our trip to South Carolina. No leaks! Good quality product. Glad we purchased these.

reviews.t: Meh
reviews.x: Don't leak but they take on water if in the line of the shower head. My body wash and shampoo get extremely watered down.

reviews.t: These are a great essential oil lotion and cream set
reviews.x: I just ordered my third set. These are a great essential oil lotion and cream set.  I couldn’t be more pleased.

reviews.t: Five Stars
reviews.x: Great selection of sizes--looks to be wonderfully leak-proof.  Love the labels!!

reviews.t: Eh.
reviews.x: The little pots are great but I wish the seals were as waterproof as advertised. I'm happy I kept them in the carrying case it came in and THEN my plastic Vera toiletries case. I'm relieved I didn't put Rose Jam in the there like I wanted to. Such a waste and super sticky mess. It's also embarassing because I got a set over a year ago as a gift for someone and wanted to buy the same brand for myself since I was now in the market, and I did so much research. Disappointed that this is what I gave

reviews.t: The squeeze bottles come easily apart and do not seal
reviews.x: Nothing in this set keeps liquids or shampoo contained.  The cheap plastic container's bag  zipper went of track after first use.  The squeeze bottles come easily apart and do not seal.  Dispersed lotion, shampoo, body wash and conditioner comes out in one big oversized glob.  Over half of my products leaked out - no good seals and in trying to get the last bit out of the squeeze bottles is hopeless.  Sending entire set back for refund, including the lotion I can't get out.

reviews.t: Works well overall. My only complaint is the smaller ...
reviews.x: Works well overall. My only complaint is the smaller one (arguably the container you will use for something you only need to use a little of at one time) releases about a tablespoon of soap with each squeeze. I tried more or less air in the container and squeezing the tube from different spots but it didn't work. I ended up unscrewing the cap each time to pull out product with my hands. Unfortunately, it started leaking in my bag over time.

reviews.t: These leak!
reviews.x: The little pots included in this set are fine, but the larger silicone bottles are downright useless. I filled them with shampoo and body wash and then stored them in a little clear travel bag within my carry on and by the time I reached my destination they had both leaked everywhere. You can tell when you fill them that there will be many opportunities between the cap and the bottle for leakage. I had to eventually just throw these away.

reviews.t: This is the BEST travel kit ever
reviews.x: This is the BEST travel kit ever!!! I absolutely 100% recommend this to others. I bought a travel pouch from Container Store to keep all the bottles. the zipper on the plastic case it comes with broke after the 5th use. I recommend buying one with with a zipper to hold these. these silicone bottles have not leaked at all.

reviews.t: Decent travel set
reviews.x: I put toner, body wash and liquid makeup remover in these for vacation. The caps can be difficult to open. I ended up getting a cut on my thumb from opening them. They're not 100% leak proof. I actually emptied the container that had body wash before repacking for my flight back, and the remnants had leaked.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report the bottles and jars are leak proof and hold up well during air and car travel.
Many reviewers praise the easy-to-squeeze silicone bottles and the wide mouth that makes filling and emptying simple.
The twist dial or ID labels for identifying contents are frequently mentioned as a useful feature.
A few reviewers complain about durability and quality issues, including caps popping off and hard plastic tubs that don't seal well.
Some reviewers note missing warnings about oil-based products and permanent labels that can't be changed.
